profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: As a full-stack software engineer, I excel in harmonizing business requirements, backend data flows, and user-centric frontend interfaces to deliver top-notch solutions. From collaborating with cross-functional teams to grasp business requirements, building robust database schemas (SQL), developing backend code and APIs (Java, Python), and building custom front-end interfaces (React.js), I seamlessly bridge the gap between frontend, backend, and functional perspectives to deliver high quality products for clients.
